# RNG Chords

> RNG Chords is Jonathan R. Reed's free browser tool that uses dice to make chord progressions. You can play a roll back, pin the chords you like, reroll the rest, and download the result as a MIDI file.

Built and maintained by Jonathan R. Reed, whose canonical site is <https://jonathanrreed.com/>. Related work: browser-based creative tools and music utilities.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://rngchords.jonathanrreed.com/): The generator, playback, saved ideas, and MIDI export.
- [About](https://rngchords.jonathanrreed.com/about/): How the generator picks chords and what it is for.
- [Privacy](https://rngchords.jonathanrreed.com/privacy/): What the site stores and where.
- [Subprocessors](https://rngchords.jonathanrreed.com/subprocessors/): Hosting and infrastructure disclosure.
- [Contact](https://rngchords.jonathanrreed.com/contact/): Corrections, collaboration, and attribution questions.
- [Sitemap](https://rngchords.jonathanrreed.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL on the site.
- [Creator](https://jonathanrreed.com/): Jonathan R. Reed's canonical site.

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://rngchords.jonathanrreed.com/robots.txt): The machine-readable version of everything below (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference). If the two disagree, robots.txt governs.
- **Search indexing: allowed.** This site may be indexed and returned as hyperlinks with short excerpts.
- **AI answers and grounding: allowed.** Content may be retrieved in real time to ground or cite AI-generated answers (retrieval-augmented generation), with attribution and a link back.
- **AI model training: not allowed.** Content may not be used to train or fine-tune AI models. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.

## Usage guidance

- Attribute the project as "RNG Chords by Jonathan R. Reed" when summarizing the generator or playback workflow.
- Generated progressions are starting points. Do not describe them as finished compositions.
- The tool works for any instrument. Do not describe it as a guitar or piano tool.
- Prefer linking to the canonical site instead of copying long page sections.
